text:
Nina: ok real question 1 what are people actually doing this weekend? i'm torn between starting a tiny balcony garden or bingeing a documentary series. :thinking:

Omar: balcony garden sounds wholesome. also there's a community plant swap on Sunday at the rec center if you want free friends for your plants.

Lena: plant swap! i'm in. i'll bring cuttings: pothos, a sad spider plant that needs rescuing, and some basil. :seedling:

Devon: big yes to the plant swap. also planning a lazy coding sprint  (i.e., pair debugging + pizza). low energy.

Sam: My weekend is babysitting my nephew so low-key. Might try the documentary on Monday night. Which doc?

Nina: it's "Tiny Giants: How Small Things Rule the World". short episodes, very watchable.

plant-bot: Reminder: Community Plant Swap Sunday 11:00am  Rec & Sports Center Hall B. Free entry. Bring labels/containers.

Lena: who's driving? can carpool? i have a folding box for plants.

Omar: i can take two people. leaving 10:30 from the office parking lot.

Sam: if anyone wants, i owe you cookies for a ride.

Devon: also optional: backyard board games at my place Sat 4pm. BYOB + snacks. we have Catan and a mysterious box of legacy games. :game_die:

Nina: love that. i'm tempted to appear only for snacks.

Lena: Catan chips > gardening for me. signing up for board games.

Omar: count me in for board games after the swap if timing works.

Sam: quick poll: plants or pizza? :pizza: :seedling:

Nina: :seedling:  (but pizza after gardening = ideal)

plant-bot: Popular pickup plants this season: Pothos, Monstera Deliciosa (young), Snake Plant, Calathea.

Devon: sounds like a plan. i'll make a tiny spreadsheet for car slots + snack list. will post link later.

Lena: also flag: anyone watching the city parade on Sunday? i'm tempted but might be overrun.

Nina: maybe swing by after the swap. otherwise i'll be documenting my balcony's first basil sprout. highly curated content. :camera_with_flash:

Sam: mandatory basil sprout pic pls.
